# CANDIDATE: RESCUE_EXIT_LOGIC_VALIDATION

**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that adjusting the exit logic (e.g., tightening stop on losers, allowing winners to run via trailing profit-lock) will increase edge capture on J winner days while reducing or avoiding losses on J loser days, thereby achieving OP-16 edge_capture >=771.

## Mechanism

Current engine uses chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock trailing 0.15, premium stop -50% (Safe). Rescue exit logic will modify: (1) reduce premium stop to -30% for bearish setups to cut losers faster, (2) increase trailing profit-lock trail_pct to 0.25 to let winners run further, (3) add a time-based exit earlier on losers (e.g., exit if premium < -20% after 20 minutes). Entry logic remains BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON trigger.
